title: libparted-fs-resize0-3.8-1.1 on GA media
description: A flaw was found in parted. A heap-based buffer overflow can occur when processing a specially crafted FAT32 filesystem due to an integer calculation error during buffer allocation. A local attacker could exploit this by enticing a user or automated service to open a malicious filesystem image, resulting in an application crash leading to a Denial of Service (DoS) or potential memory corruption.
aiSummary: The libparted-fs-resize0-3.8-1.1 package for openSUSE Tumbleweed's GA media contains several security issues that have been fixed. No detailed technical information or CVSS score is available for CVE-2026-89085, and no affected versions are explicitly stated. The vendor is SUSE Product Security Team.
aiImpact: The impact is assessed as medium severity based on the provided metadata. No information about exploitation in the wild or specific impacts is available.
